zones.name: SAFE
zones.description: Exposure within ACGIH 1 ppm TWA baseline threshold.

zones.name: CAUTION
zones.action: Increase ventilation, monitor area, check strip every 2 hours.
zones.description: Approaching ACGIH TWA threshold (1-3 ppm sustained).

zones.name: WARNING
zones.action: Rotate personnel, inspect seals and valves, notify supervisor.
zones.description: At ACGIH 5 ppm STEL / 50% DGMS 8-hr shift limit.

zones.name: ALERT
zones.action: Mandatory respiratory PPE (SCBA/air-line), prepare area evacuation.
zones.description: Reaching NIOSH 10 ppm REL ceiling / 100% DGMS shift limit.

zones.name: DANGER
zones.action: IMMEDIATE EVACUATION of personnel from exposure sector.
zones.description: Exceeded DGMS 80 ppm·h shift limit. OSHA 20 ppm ceiling violation.

zones.name: LIFE_THREATENING
zones.action: CRITICAL EMERGENCY: Trigger siren, initiate rescue protocol.
zones.description: Approaching IDLH (100 ppm instantaneous). Severe risk of olfactory paralysis.
